request.title: Add a postinstall script to package.json that prints "installed"
request.scope: Project: calc-bug (/data1/yccho/tig-demo/calc-bug), a tiny Node calculator. The only file to change is package.json at the project root. It is an ES module ("type": "module", version 1.0.0) with one existing script: "scripts": { "test": "node --test" }. Add a new "postinstall" entry to the "scripts" object, with the value: node -e "console.log('installed')". In the JSON file the inner double quotes must be escaped, so the stored value is "node -e \"console.log('installed')\"". Keep the existing "test" script exactly as it is. Expected end state: running npm install in the project executes the postinstall command and prints "installed". Assumption: the requester wants the script in the project's own package.json (not in a sub-package or a lifecycle hook elsewhere), and the project has no dependencies, so npm install is only expected to run the postinstall hook. Assumption: no other files (src/calc.js, test/calc.test.js, README.md) need to change. The git commit "calc with a bug" is the current state; do not fix any bug in src/ as part of this task.
acceptanceChecks: package.json is valid JSON and its scripts object contains "postinstall" with the value node -e "console.log('installed')" (escaped in the file as \"console.log('installed')\").
Running npm install in the project prints installed.
The "test" script in package.json is still "node --test".
git diff shows changes only in package.json, and only in the scripts object.
request.originalRequest: Add a postinstall script to package.json that runs node -e "console.log('installed')"
request.context: Project folder: calc-bug. Git: branch main at 03f0f37; 0 changed and 0 new file(s) not yet committed. Tracked files: 4. Top level: README.md, package.json, src, test.
constraints: Change only the "scripts" object in package.json; keep the "name", "version", "type" and the existing "test" script unchanged.
Do not add dependencies, devDependencies, or a lockfile.
Do not modify src/, test/, or README.md.
Do not add any other lifecycle scripts (preinstall, install, prepare, etc.) beyond the requested postinstall.
setupSteps: Run npm install in the project root (/data1/yccho/tig-demo/calc-bug). This is the setup detected from the project; the project declares no dependencies, so it should only run the postinstall hook.
Confirm Node.js is available on the PATH, since the postinstall command calls node.
testSteps: Run npm install in the project root and confirm the output includes the line: installed
Run npm pkg get scripts (or open package.json) and confirm postinstall and test entries are present and correct.

Run npm test and confirm it still invokes node --test. Note: the existing commit "calc with a bug" may cause test failures in src/calc.js; a failure there is not caused by this change and should be reported as-is, not fixed as part of this task.
Run git diff and confirm only the scripts object in package.json changed.
